findings.finding: voiceStateUpdate returns when streaming, mute, deaf or video flags differ; this suppresses those logs and may suppress simultaneous channel transition.
channelUpdate uses if/else-if for name/type/topic; permission overwrites, position and other fields are not comprehensively diffed.
roleUpdate uses if/else-if for name/color and does not capture all simultaneous changes or permission changes.
messageDelete renders cached content/author without an explicit unavailable-data state; partial messages can produce misleading output.
send errors are swallowed; no durable event/delivery receipt is established by this helper.
Explicit intent list does not include scheduled events, AutoMod configuration/execution or guild poll votes. Add only when their consumers are enabled.
Guild wrapper skips its event-file handler while DB is unavailable; define bounded redacted capture/degradation rather than silently assuming no gap.

guarantee: All items in the retrieved reference receive a disposition; does not promise all real-world Discord activity is visible or retained.
